description:
Mahatma Gandhi Yojana (MGY) is a government welfare scheme aimed at providing financial assistance to the rural population. 

The scheme was launched to promote self-employment and entrepreneurship among rural youth. 

The primary objective is to enhance the livelihood opportunities for the rural poor. 

Under this scheme financial support is provided for setting up small businesses and enterprises. 

The assistance includes subsidies and loans to help beneficiaries start their ventures. 

Eligibility criteria include being a resident of rural areas and belonging to economically weaker sections. 

Applicants must also be within a certain age limit typically between 18 to 45 years. 

The application process involves submitting a detailed project report along with required documents to the concerned authorities. 

Applications can be submitted online or through designated government offices. 

The timeline for disbursal of funds varies based on the assessment of the application. 

The scheme is implemented by the Ministry of Rural Development at the national level. 

State governments may also have their own specific guidelines and procedures for implementation. 

Additional details about the scheme can be accessed on official government websites.
